audience: businesses that look up existing fiscal documents in their own Invoice Maven account

useCases.title: Find existing documents by search
useCases.text: Read a page of existing Invoice Maven documents, up to 20 per page. The search never creates, issues or cancels fiscal documents.

useCases.title: Page through documents for a bookkeeping check
useCases.text: Read the next page of existing documents to check them against your own bookkeeping records.

useCases.title: Summarize search results for a colleague
useCases.text: Search existing documents and summarize the results for a colleague who needs them.
